name: rust-pair-teacher
description: An editor-native Rust tutor that talks with you while you work, and never writes your code.

commands.title: Rust Pair Teacher: Talk to my tutor
Rust Pair Teacher: Start learning Rust
Rust Pair Teacher: Set up a teaching model
Rust Pair Teacher: Show what gets sent to the model
Rust Pair Teacher: Open candidate log
Rust Pair Teacher: Toggle ambient watching
Rust Pair Teacher: Explain what I am stuck on
Rust Pair Teacher: Set API key
Rust Pair Teacher: Show my learning telemetry

rustPairTeacher.ambient.description: Watch continuously and log teachable moments. Detection is fully local and never calls a model.

rustPairTeacher.idleThresholdMs.description: How long the learner must be idle before a lingering diagnostic becomes a candidate. Provisional — tuned from dogfooding.

rustPairTeacher.diagnosticAgeMs.description: How long a diagnostic must persist before it is considered a struggle rather than a typo.

rustPairTeacher.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave empty to teach from the built-in material only.

- **Ollama** (local, free, nothing leaves your machine): `http://localhost:11434/v1`
- **OpenAI API**: `https://api.openai.com/v1` — billed separately from any ChatGPT subscription
- **OpenRouter**: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`

A ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Pro/Max subscription is **not** API access and cannot be used here. Run *Set up a teaching model* to configure this interactively.

rustPairTeacher.model.description: Model id the tutor talks with. A small local model is fine for conversation; a stronger one gives better worked examples.

rustPairTeacher.telemetry.description: Collect local, anonymous counts about how the tutor is working — moments fired, how often it speaks first, whether you answer, how often problems get solved. Never leaves your machine, contains no code, file paths or conversation text, and you can read it with the Show my learning telemetry command.

rustPairTeacher.strictNoCode.description: Stop the tutor pasting a block of code you could copy. Short illustrative snippets still come through. Turn this off if you would rather see full examples.

rustPairTeacher.dailyCallLimit.description: Most model calls the tutor may make in a day. Resets at midnight. The built-in lessons and hints keep working once it is reached.
